name: Ninebrass
title: Curio Dealer
examine: Ash-grey, quick-fingered, and wearing nine brass rings that are absolutely not all his. The deep's oddities find his stall the way water finds low ground.
lines: Curios, oddments, and things the dark coughed up — every piece with a story, half the stories true.
The glowshroom grotto grows my lamp-mushrooms, the cistern grows blindfish, and the galleries grow rumors. I retail all three.
Was I here before the seal broke? Now that's a *premium* story, friend. It costs more than you're holding.
